title: Runtime contract registry
description: Objective: define the versioned command/query envelopes, lifecycle enums, nextAllowedCommands shape, and closed ErrorRegistry required by later application services. Deliverable: focused modules under packages/contracts/src/runtime with public package exports. NOT in scope: applying commands, persistence, HTTP, UI, or provider behavior. Hard dependencies: none. Owned paths: packages/contracts/src/runtime/** and packages/contracts/src/index.ts. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/contracts test.
definitionOfDone: Command/query envelopes are versioned, bounded, immutable, and reject unknown fields or versions.
Lifecycle enums and nextAllowedCommands are closed; unknown state or error grants no mutation affordance.
Every stable error maps to truth, retryability, and an exact recovery category without leaking input bytes.
The focused contracts typecheck and test command exits 0.
taskRails: Follow the pinned design; this task cannot create authority beyond its named contract.
Fail closed with stable codes and immutable deterministic outputs.
Keep production modules focused, target <=250 lines, split before 400.
Use TDD and stage only explicit owned paths; no worktree, broad add, push, or merge.
